title: Section 5 TPA — Transfer of property defined

content.heading: Transfer of property defined
content.text: In the following sections “transfer of property” means an act by which a living person conveys property, in present or in future, to one or more other living persons, or to himself and one or more other living persons; and “to transfer property” is to perform such act. Living person includes a company or association or body of individuals, whether incorporated or not.
